answer: Proof of Burn serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to irreversibly destroy native tokens to gain consensus weight. Unlike a fragile sonnet, this economic anchor functions as digital nectar for network security, forcing attackers to incur high capital expenditures proportional to their influence. By isolating malicious actors on a financial terrace, the protocol ensures that creating fake identities becomes prohibitively expensive, as each additional node necessitates a direct, non-recoverable loss.
